title: Certify the T740 phase normal form for every owner and port
body:
## Summary

Extend PR3297's fixed owner-0/port-0 phase normal form to every actual T740 owner and port.

```text
2,717,280 literal hosted rows
  no-shear transport at every placement
82,880 owner/port contexts
  hosted prefix plus residual becomes the full child
112 exact port words
  the same 72-term, twenty-site matrix
```

The new result is the hosting implication and complete source coverage. PR3297's inverse and rank consequence are inherited, not independently re-proved. Ross Richardson's earlier related local-only normalization handoff is credited. This package does not depend on another pending audit.

## Evidence

- Before: PR3297 explicitly covers only owner 0 / port 0.
- After: every expanded fill row passes the transport premise; the complete fill hash matches, and all 112 symbolic port words match the retained matrix. Eleven control groups pass normally and under `-O`.
- The complete registered CPython 3.12.15 replay passes. All 19 committed package/input files match. The exact committed export passes read-only, Git-free optimized replay and controls with `PATH=/nonexistent`.

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/t740-all-context-normalization
```

Exact canonical source pins, unchanged PR3297 proof/result exports, proof, deterministic receipt, attribution, limits and open next questions are in `research/t740-all-context-normalization/`.

This is a fixed completed-call Fourier-model result. No changed-interface legality, native execution, paid consumer/caller admission, full multiplication theorem, new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way.

Blast Radius: isolated research package. Frozen inputs and shared tools are unchanged. Hosted CI is tracked on the exact PR head separately from local verification.
